connector.name: Webhound
connector.registryDescription: Budgeted reports and datasets with Hound, Webhound's DeepSeek V4 Pro + GPT-5.4 research harness.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.webhound.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package webhound-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.webhound, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.
